member: Farah — Post-Harvest and Cooperative Operations Specialist
message:
Surya, Lena, Kofi, one tonne fits in hand-carry boxes using the stackable vented crates (C7), where food-grade means safe plastic for direct produce contact. Plain words, shallow vented boxes keep air moving and stay light to lift. Numbers are 600 by 400 mm footprint per plastic2go.com.au — Best Folding Vented 600x400 Plastic Crates for Sale (E26) with 300 mm height, about 60 crates at 15 to 20 kg each to make 1000 kg, sane against a bucket of water per lift and inside the 2 by 2 by 2.2 m box.

Access fits a person with a box using the two side racks with centre aisle (C8). Plain words, low side shelves leave a walkway and gaps for cold air and mopping. Numbers are crates stacked 3 high to about 1.2 m reach, 100 mm wall and floor gaps and single 900 mm door per Interior plan and section: two side racks, centre aisle, 900 mm door, wall and floor air gaps (E36), with gross volume sane against about 3.4 cubic m per tonne for potato per coolingindia.in — Design of Cold Storage for Fruits & Vegetables ... (E29).

Daily use stays clean using the washable hygienic routine (C9), where First-In-First-Out (FIFO) means oldest crates sold first. Plain words, smooth liners and raised washable floor plus outside crate washing limit rot. Numbers are smooth, impervious, washable surfaces required per faolex.fao.org — mlt35655.max (E34). Not ready, because Kofi must confirm rack loads and door frame.
